item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #MINPRSD
Issued at 05:00 AM 18 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaCity, #ZamboangaSibugay, #ZamboangaDelSur, #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sibuco, Sirawai, Siocon, Tampilisan, Kalawit, Gutalac, Godod, Labason, Salug, Liloy, LeonB.Postigo, Siayan, SergioOsmeñaSr., Sindangan, Mutia, JoseDalman, Sibutad, Manukan, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas, Katipunan, DipologCity, Polanco, Piñan, DapitanCity, LaLibertad, Rizal), #MisamisOccidental, #LanaoDelSur(Maguing, Marogong, Lumbatan, Masiu, Lumbayanague, LumbaBayabao), #Bukidnon(Talakag, Baungon), #Camiguin, #MisamisOriental(Lugait, Manticao, Naawan, Initao, Gitagum, Libertad, Laguindingan, Balingoan, Kinoguitan, Talisayan, Sugbongcogon), #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, SanFrancisco) and #DinagatIslands within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #ZamboangaDelNorte(Baliguian), #LanaoDelSur(Butig and SultanDumalondong) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
